verdict.rationale: The only documented deletion control is for memories: users can add, edit, or delete stored memories in Settings > Personalization > Memory. Self-hosted and offline operation affects where data lives, not retention controls, so it earns no credit here. missing for 10: chat/conversation deletion controls, configurable retention periods or auto-expiry policies, deletion of uploaded files/RAG data, admin-level retention settings, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Users can manually add, edit, or delete memories by navigating to: Settings > Personalization > Memory
